contract.task_clause:
Which of the following describes the _tu quoque_ fallacy?
Option A: summarizing an opponent's position in a way that makes it seem silly
Option B: attempting to gain agreement based only on the feelings aroused in the argument
Option C: responding to charges of wrongdoing by saying the accuser does the same thing
Option D: arguing against a position based only on negative personal feelings toward the position
